description: This file contains image comparison utilities, including functions for pixel drawing, color difference calculation, and image diff analysis using SSIM and variance metrics.

classes.name: ImageChannel
classes.description: Class for handling image channel data and operations.

classes.name: FastStats
classes.description: Class for calculating fast statistical measures on image data.

methods.description: Draws a pixel with specified RGB values at given coordinates.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two image buffers and optionally outputs a diff image, using color difference and SSIM metrics.
